title: Target policy
description: A target's .factory/policy.yaml (P2-05), read by policy-check from the base branch only: the factory App whose verdicts count, the people whose approval clears R3, and the target's protected and restricted paths, which can only raise a tier.

app_id.description: The factory GitHub App's ID: a factory/verdict check run from any other app is ignored.

approvers.description: GitHub logins whose approving review on the head commit clears R3 and needs_human.
